What is FLUFENZINE 20% EC?

FLUFENZINE 20% EC (YODDHA) is a premium emulsifiable concentrate miticide and acaricide by Harishree Crop Science for controlling red spider mites, yellow mites, and broad mites on chilli, cotton, brinjal, tomato, okra, cucurbits, vegetables, fruits, and horticulture crops. Recommended dose: 25 ml per pump.

How does FLUFENZINE 20% EC work?

Contact acaricidal activity and mite growth regulation — Flufenzine disrupts mite feeding, development, and reproductive cycles on treated foliage.

  1. 1

    Contact activity on mites

    On application, YODDHA forms an even EC deposit on leaf surfaces. Mites contacting treated foliage absorb the active ingredient, disrupting normal feeding and movement.

  2. 2

    Mite growth disruption

    Flufenzine interferes with mite development pathways, affecting moulting and growth regulation so nymphs fail to reach reproductive adulthood.

  3. 3

    Reproductive cycle control

    By impacting egg viability and nymph survival, YODDHA breaks the mite reproductive cycle, preventing rapid population explosions during hot dry periods.

  4. 4

    Residual protection

    The EC formulation adheres to foliage and maintains acaricidal activity on treated surfaces, protecting against newly colonizing mite populations between sprays.

  5. 5

    Long-term mite suppression

    Combined contact knockdown and growth regulation deliver sustained mite population suppression when applied at economic threshold with thorough coverage.

  6. 6

    Crop protection benefits

    Reduced mite feeding preserves leaf integrity, photosynthetic area, and plant vigour — supporting healthier chilli, cotton, and vegetable crops through harvest.

Target pests

YODDHA delivers strong contact and growth-regulation activity against major mite species when applied at early infestation with full leaf underside coverage.

Red Spider Mites

Controls Tetranychus species that cause bronzing, webbing, and defoliation on chilli, cotton, brinjal, tomato, and vegetable foliage at early infestation.

Yellow Mites

Effective against Polyphagotarsonemus latus and related yellow mite species that distort leaves and reduce photosynthesis in chilli and solanaceous crops.

Two-Spotted Spider Mites

Manages Tetranychus urticae populations on cucumber, melon, tomato, and other horticulture crops when sprayed with underside leaf coverage.

Broad Mites

Provides activity against broad mite species that cause leaf curling, russeting, and stunted growth on pepper, chilli, and ornamental horticulture crops.

Various Mite Species

Broad acaricidal spectrum covers mixed mite complexes on vegetables, fruits, and horticulture crops when applied at economic threshold with full coverage.

FLUFENZINE 20% EC dose

Clear, field-ready guidance for using YODDHA effectively.

Recommended dose

25 ml per pump in a standard 15-litre knapsack sprayer. Confirm crop-wise rate on the label.

Mixing instructions

Half-fill with water, add 25 ml YODDHA, top up, and agitate. The EC formulation emulsifies easily for uniform spray coverage on leaf surfaces.

Best spray timing

Apply at early mite infestation or ETL during calm morning or evening hours with emphasis on leaf undersides where mites colonize.

Safety guidelines

PPE, storage, disposal, and first aid guidance for safe use of YODDHA.

25 ml accurate dose PPE & environment

Usage best practices

Mix clean, spray calm, scout again after a few days.

  • 1

    Wear proper PPE

    Always wear gloves, protective clothing, goggles, and a fitted mask when handling concentrate or preparing the spray mix.

  • 2

    Accurate 25 ml dose

    Measure exactly 25 ml per pump to maintain efficacy, protect crops, and slow resistance development in mite populations.

  • 3

    Spray for full coverage

    Apply in calm weather and cover leaf undersides where red spider mites, yellow mites, and broad mites colonize and feed.

Storage, disposal & first aid

Respect the label hazard panel and local disposal rules.

  • 4

    Safe storage

    Store upright in original container in a cool, dry, locked place away from food, feed, seed, and children.

  • 5

    Container disposal

    Triple-rinse empty bottles, puncture them, and dispose as per local pesticide container management rules.

  • 6

    First aid readiness

    If product contacts skin or eyes, wash thoroughly with water. If swallowed or symptoms appear, seek medical help immediately with the label.

Compatibility & tank mix

YODDHA is generally compatible with commonly used insecticides and fungicides when tank-mixed for integrated crop protection programs. Always perform a jar test before mixing to confirm physical compatibility. Avoid alkaline mixes that may degrade active ingredients. Consult your local Harishree dealer or agronomist for crop-specific tank-mix recommendations.

Resistance management

Dedicated acaricidal chemistry in YODDHA supports focused mite management when rotated with other mode-of-action groups. For sustainable mite control, rotate YODDHA with contact miticides, IGRs, and other acaricide classes across the season and avoid repeated applications of the same chemistry.
